title: A Drop for the Asset
author: Elodie Whitlock
blurb: Ivo Iversen, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
